components.note: 氵 (water) — water and mixing liquids, as in 河, 海, 清: 混 is to mix or muddy.
昆 (kūn) is a close sound clue for hùn; 昆 also in 棍 gùn.
虫 (insect, creature) — small animals and insects, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蛇 snake, 虾 shrimp: 蛋 is the egg of a creature.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 们: 保 oldest form shows a person carrying a child on the back, so to protect.
呆 here is the old child shape 子 beside the person, a picture of keeping safe.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢: to prove by saying.
正 (zhèng) gives the exact sound; 正 also in 整 zhěng and 政 zhèng.
子 (child) — a child learning under a roof: the top shows hands over a house, and the child 子 below. Also gives 觉 jué its upper part.
木 (tree) — wood and trees, as in 树, 林, 桌: 校 first meant a wooden frame or restraint.
交 (jiāo) is a close sound clue for xiào; 交 also in 较 jiào and 校 xiào.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: receiving something by hand.
妾 (qiè) is only a loose sound clue for jiē.
又 (hand) — two hands pass a vessel: one gives, one receives; 授 shòu adds 扌 for "give".
攵 (tap, strike) — hand holding a stick, as in 教 teach, 收 collect, 放 release: correcting by hand.
己 (jǐ) is a close sound clue for gǎi.
广 (shelter) — a building, as in 店, 床, 度: hemp stalks drying in a shed. 麻 also gives sound to 磨 mó, 摩 mó and 魔 mó.
火 (fire) — heat and burning, as in 灯 lamp, 烧 burn, 热 hot: a hot, fevered head, hence vexed.
页 (head) is a loose sound clue for fán; as a meaning part 页 means head or page.
⺮ (bamboo) — bamboo, as in 笔 pen, 等 wait, 第: counting rods were once bamboo.
具 (jù, tool) — here the lower part shows hands holding the counting tools.
彡 (strokes of light or hair) — shining or decoration, as in 形 shape, 彩 colour, 须 beard.
景 (jǐng) is a close sound clue for yǐng; 景 itself meant light; 影 is its shadow.
身 (body) — a person's body with a rounded belly. As a radical it marks body words: 躺 lie down, 躲 hide, 躯 body.
⺮ (bamboo) — bamboo, as in 笔, 等, 算: a hollow pipe.
官 (guān) is a close sound clue for guǎn; 官 also in 馆 guǎn and 棺 guān.
牛 (ox) — cattle and animals, as in 物 thing, 牧 herd, 牺 sacrifice: 特 first meant a bull, then special.
寺 (sì) is only a loose sound clue for tè; 寺 also in 诗 shī and 持 chí.
氵 (water) — water and pouring, as in 河, 海, 清: 注 is to pour in.
主 (zhǔ) is a close sound clue for zhù; 主 also in 住 zhù, 柱 zhù and 驻 zhù.
甘 (sweet) — sweet taste, as in 甜: 甚 first meant great enjoyment, then "very, extremely".
至 (arrive) — oldest form is an arrow landing on a mark: to reach. 至 sounds out 到 dào and 致 zhì, and sits in 室 shì room and 屋 wū.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: guarding with the hands.
户 (hù, door) gives the exact sound; 户 means door or household.
止 (foot) — a foot heading straight for a target line: upright, correct. 正 gives sound to 证 zhèng, 整 zhěng and 政 zhèng.
衣 (clothes; 衤 on the left) — the outer garment.
毛 (fur) — a fur coat worn outside: the outside, the surface, then to show.
辶 (walk) — movement, as in 过, 近, 送: to go forward.
井 stands in for 隹 of 進, a loose clue only.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads, as in 红, 给, 经: cutting a thread, hence to break off.
色 (sè) is only a loose sound clue for jué.
长 (long, grow) — simplified from 長, an old person with long hair. Read cháng "long" or zhǎng "to grow, elder".
宀 (roof) — a public building where officials work; 官 is an official.
官 (guān) gives the sound of 管 guǎn, 馆 guǎn and 棺 guān.
彳 (step) — walking and conduct, as in 行, 往, 得, 很.
聿 (brush) — writing the rules: 律 is law, and a rule of rhythm.
师 (shī) is a sound clue for 狮 shī (lion) and 筛 shāi; as a word it means master or teacher.
正 (zhèng) is a close sound clue for zhěng; 正 also means correct, fitting for putting things in order.
攵 (tap, strike) — hand with stick, as in 教, 收, 改: setting things right by force.
氵 (water) — water and flow, as in 河, 海, 清: 演 first meant a long flowing stream, then spreading out and performing.
寅 (yín) is a close sound clue for yǎn.
辶 (walk) — movement and roads, as in 过, 近, 送: following the edge. The part 力 stands in for 臱 in the traditional 邊.
古 (gǔ) is a close sound clue for gù; 古 also in 姑 gū and 固 gù.
攵 (tap, strike) — hand with stick, as in 教, 收, 改: an action with a cause.
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈, 她, 姐.
昏 (hūn, dusk) gives the exact sound; weddings were traditionally held at dusk, so the sound clue is also a meaning clue.
口 (mouth) — speech, as in 吃, 唱, 问: a spoken pronoun.
自 (zì) is only a loose sound clue for zán.
夂 (foot) — stopping or going: 处 first meant to stay or settle, then a place or to deal with.
王 (jade) — jade and gems, as in 球 ball, 玩 play, 现 appear: 理 first meant polishing jade along its grain, then reason.
里 (lǐ) gives the exact sound; also in 鲤 lǐ.
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈, 她, 姐; oldest form shows a hand arranging a woman's hair, a wife.
彳 (step) — left half of a crossroads: 行 pictures a crossroads, so to go, and (háng) a row or trade.
不 (bù) is a loose sound clue for fǒu and gives the meaning "not".
口 (mouth) — speech, as in 吃, 唱, 问: saying no.
刂 (knife) — cutting, as in 到, 分, 别: hard enough to cut.
冈 (gāng) gives the exact sound; also in 钢 gāng and 纲 gāng.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 桌, 树, 板: 案 is a wooden table.
安 (ān) is a close sound clue for àn; also in 按 àn.
力 (strength) — effort and motion, as in 办, 助, 努. The part 云 stands in for 重 in the traditional 動, which was the sound clue.
二 (two) — two parallel strokes: the next step after 一 and before 三.
力 (strength) — effort, as in 办, 助, 动: to exert strength.
奴 (nú) is a close sound clue for nǔ; 奴 also in 怒 nù.
力 (strength) — an old picture of an arm or a plough, a tool of effort. As a radical it marks strength: 办, 助, 动, 努, 男.
害 (hài) is a loose sound clue for 割 gē and 辖 xiá; as a word it means to harm, as in 厉害.
忄 (heart) — feelings, as in 快, 忙, 情: fear is a feeling.
白 (bái) is a close sound clue for pà; 白 also in 拍 pāi and 伯 bó.
讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢.
周 (zhōu) is a loose sound clue for diào/tiáo; 周 also in 凋 diāo.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 树, 桌, 板: 查 first meant a raft of wood. 查 also gives 渣 zhā and 楂 zhā.
